release_notes: Date: 2026-10-17 - DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 Update. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash has been upgraded to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017. The official web and APP models have also been updated to the new version. The API calling method and pricing remain unchanged — simply use deepseek-flash to access the latest model.

Date: 2026-09-10 - DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Release. Today, we officially release the DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash model. It is the smallest model in our new architecture family, with native multimodal visual understanding. Change the model name to deepseek-flash to call the latest V4.1 Flash model. The previous-generation models V4 Flash and V4 Flash Vision Exp have been retired; for compatibility, the model names deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp are temporarily routed to V4.1 Flash.

Date: 2026-08-13 - DeepSeek-V4-Pro Update. The GA release of DeepSeek-V4-Pro has been rolled out on the APP, Web, and API. The API calling method remains unchanged — simply set the model name to deepseek-v4-pro to use the latest version.

Date: 2026-04-24 - DeepSeek-V4. The two legacy API model names, deepseek-chat and deepseek-reasoner, will be discontinued in three months (2026-07-24). During the current period, these two model names point to the non-thinking mode and thinking mode of deepseek-v4-flash, respectively. To access the new models, the base_url remains unchanged, and the model parameter should be set to deepseek-v4-pro or deepseek-v4-flash.

raw_markdown_thinking:
The DeepSeek model supports the thinking mode: before outputting the final answer, the model will first output a chain-of-thought reasoning to improve the accuracy of the final response.

Thinking Mode Toggle and Effort Control:
- OpenAI Format: thinking: {type: enabled/disabled}, reasoning_effort: low/high/max
- Anthropic Format: reasoning: {effort: none/low/high/max}, output_config: {effort: low/high/max}
- Default thinking mode enabled, default effort high.

Requested effort -> Actual mapped effort:
minimal -> low; low -> low; medium -> high; high -> high; xhigh -> high; max -> max; ultra -> max
